description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). What's cooking right now: every timer with time left, the next buzz, and whether the phone's backup alarm is armed. Call this first — it returns the server clock, the kitchen's timezone, and the ids and labels every other tool accepts.

include.description: Extra sections. 'settings' the kitchen defaults; 'changelog' recent app releases (the What's new list); 'laps' the full flip log per timer instead of just a count; 'devices' every paired phone and its push health. Default: none — live timers only, which is the cheap common call.

name: kitchen_status

availableActions.description: The exact values control_timers accepts, so you never have to guess.

phone.description: The paired phone: push health, last sync, armed alarms.

summary.description: Counts per state, the timer finishing soonest, and nextPlanned: the next waiting (scheduled) dish with its start and the meal's ready time as ISO dates, which may be days away.

timers.description: Every timer on the board, oldest first.

elapsed.description: A stopwatch only: the time on its clock as m:ss.

elapsedMs.description: A stopwatch only: the time on its clock in milliseconds.

finishMayMove.description: Present with waitsForFlips: the finish time moves by however long each flip takes.

flips.description: How many flips have been logged.

kind.description: Only on a stopwatch (it counts up, has no deadline and never rings): remaining and duration mean nothing for it, read elapsed. Create one with start_timers stopwatch:true and drive it with control_timers (flag stopwatch).

laps.description: Full flip log; only with include:['laps'].

nextBuzz.description: Countdown to the next buzz, e.g. 'in 1:48'.

origin.description: Who last wrote it: app, mcp or server.

recorded.description: This run has been written to history.

reminders.description: How this timer buzzes before it finishes.

every.description: Interval as a duration string, when mode is 'interval'.

stepNames.description: Optional names the cook gave the stages on the phone (e.g. 'Cheese on'), parallel to steps; '' = unnamed. Set on the phone only.

ringing.description: The finish alarm is probably still sounding on the phone.

scheduledStartAt.description: When a scheduled dish starts, ISO 8601.

scheduledStartAtMs.description: When a scheduled dish starts, epoch ms.

state.description: 'scheduled' is a finish-together dish waiting for its start moment.

waitedMs.description: Total time this run has spent waiting for flips so far.

waitingForFlip.description: Holding at a flip right now (state 'paused'); nothing counts down until the cook flips. control_timers 'start' = ✓ Flipped.

waitingSince.description: When the current wait for a flip began (ISO).

waitsForFlips.description: kt-v35 flip-wait timer: it holds at every flip until the cook confirms, so endsAt is only a best case.

timezone.description: The kitchen's IANA timezone, as reported by the phone.

warnings.description: Things worth saying out loud that are not failures.

title: Kitchen status
